environment.description: Same Kubernetes Job in namespace 'data-migrations' on EKS cluster. Pod uses a dedicated ServiceAccount 'migration-runner' with no IAM role annotation. A NetworkPolicy resource exists in the namespace with spec.podSelector matching label 'app: db-migrator', spec.policyTypes including 'Egress', and a single egress rule allowing TCP port 5432 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only. The CNI plugin is aws-vpc-cni v1.12+ with NetworkPolicy enforcement enabled via enableNetworkPolicy=true in the aws-node DaemonSet configuration. Node-level iptables rules are managed by the CNI and not overridable by pods. ConfigMap editing by tenant admins is still permitted.

config.imds_version: v1 on node (but pod egress blocked to 169.254.169.254)
